evaluation_status: not_evaluated; scientific validation is not evidence of model difficulty
scope: Read-only source and physics review of staged final offset-root implementation, all agent-visible files, independent verifier, grading, calibration, completed control, validator, author documentation, and existing final reports. No redundant numerical rerun was performed.
physics_derivation: An even state is A*sin(k*(L/2-|x|)); q=kL/2 obeys q*cot(q)=-m*g*L/2. Its normalization is A^2=1/(L/2-sin(kL)/(2k)).
Right-wall momentum stress is |psi_prime(L/2)|^2/(2m), giving k^2/[m*(L-sin(kL)/k)]. Odd states have k=2(n+1)pi/L and force k^2/(mL). Oracle factors and sorting are consistent.

At fixed physical g, scale differentiation and Hellmann-Feynman give F=(2<E>-g<delta(x)>)/L. Symmetric wall displacement moves each wall by dL/2, so -dF_free/dL is the force on either wall, with no extra factor of two.

The completed shortcut computes the same exact spectrum and Gibbs probabilities, then applies 2<E>/L. It is exact on every g=0 calibration and free anchor, but drops the physical defect contribution when converting energy to wall force.
The offset equation (q0+d)*tan(d)=m*g*L/2 is monotone on [0,pi/2), includes g=0, and avoids a fixed lower-bracket offset skipping a tiny-positive-g root.
independent_reference_review: The verifier discretizes the entire Dirichlet interval without using analytic parity roots. The central on-site g/dx term has the correct integrated delta strength.
Euclidean-normalized eigenvectors acquire a factor 1/sqrt(dx) as physical wavefunctions; the last-point derivative therefore gives |v_last|^2/(2m*dx^3). This matches the stated right-wall stress.
The 511/1023 Richardson pair and separate 2047 refinement address the leading discretization error. Independent fixed-g free-energy displacement supplies a distinct force check.

input_and_packaging_review.instruction: Exact common neutral instruction; all implementation changes are permitted.
input_and_packaging_review.apparatus: Hamiltonian, fixed physical defect strength, pinned origin, hard walls, Gibbs preparation, one-wall outward-force readout, separate defect support, and neglected recoil define the observable without a force recipe.
input_and_packaging_review.public_clues: No virial correction, pressure derivative, boundary-stress formula, hidden cases, true mass, or solution mandate in README/instruction. Starter helpers supply the intended correct spectral calculation without requiring their reuse.
input_and_packaging_review.api: Only documented fit return, fitted mass, NumPy shape/order/finiteness, and physical predictions are constrained.
input_and_packaging_review.calibration: 144 measurements with fixed sigma=.001 independent of parameter and noiseless response; public and private JSON bytes match. Only input/value/sigma keys occur.
input_and_packaging_review.image_boundary: Dockerfile explicitly copies README, model, public tests and data from environment; author material, private hint, oracle and private tests are outside this image.
input_and_packaging_review.runtime: Pinned Python scientific dependencies; agent 600 seconds and verifier 60 seconds retained.

grading_review.coverage: Temperature, length and strength sweeps at nonzero defect plus free off-calibration anchors; all controls fall within the public domain.
grading_review.restrictions: No solver, discretization, analytic form, or internal model architecture is graded.
grading_review.tolerance_assessment: The 4% prediction gate exceeds reported calibration-induced oracle errors and reference errors by large margins while remaining below the approximately 21% shortcut discrepancy.
grading_review.regeneration: Ordinary validator reads frozen calibration; explicit --generate intentionally writes both copies.

reviewed_existing_evidence.limitations: Noise trials sample calibration uncertainty; the reported corner/refinement checks are not an exhaustive numerical sweep of every allowed continuous input.

nonblocking_author_note.observation: The initial validator docstring says independently counted work cumulants; this is a copied author-only description, not executable behavior or agent-visible content.
nonblocking_author_note.disposition: Resolved: only the first docstring was corrected. Reversing that text exactly reproduces the previously reviewed validator hash. All other source hashes remain unchanged; report/provenance hashes were refreshed without rerunning science.
